title: Oven-Roasted American Chickpeas Brownies
description: Bitter, juicy brownies made with roasted chickpeas and tempered dark chocolate, a show-off American dessert that stays ayurvedic tamasic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and line an 8x8 inch baking pan with parchment paper.
Melt the chopped chocolate and coconut oil together over low heat, stirring until smooth.
Whisk the maple syrup, almond butter, vanilla extract, sea salt, baking powder, cocoa powder, and ground flaxseed into the melted chocolate mixture until well combined.
Fold in the roasted chickpeas until evenly coated.
Transfer the batter to the prepared pan and spread evenly with a spatula.
Bake for 20 minutes until the edges firm and the center remains slightly soft.
Let the brownies cool completely in the pan before cutting into squares.
Serve as is or dust with cocoa powder.
